text: {"label":"Pigeon key-peck timing and schedule performance","definition":"Laboratory studies of pigeons' key pecking under reinforcement schedules, examining timing of intervals, delays, pausing, response variability and force, midsession reversal, and drug effects on ongoing performance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on the temporal patterning and dynamics of pecking under schedules, not on choice and preference, visual discrimination and memory, or inference and distance effects in choice."}
